description: This PHP source file defines the Cod class, which is a controller for handling Cash on Delivery (COD) payment method in an OpenCart extension. It includes methods for rendering the payment view and confirming the order, interacting with session data, models, and URLs.

classes.name: Cod
classes.description: Controller class for handling COD payment logic, including rendering views and confirming orders.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language files, retrieves current language setting, and renders the COD payment view.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Validates session data and order status, updates order history, and returns JSON response indicating success or failure.
